name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.cutB_vecOf
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g)
  (K : Finset.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Tm (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)))
  (j : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} j
      (List.length.{0}
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
    Iff
      (Eq.{1}
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.cutB
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.vecOf g hv K) j)
        Bool.true)
      (Membership.mem.{0, 0} K
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) ⋯ j))

source.code:
theorem cutB_vecOf (K : Finset (g.base.Tm)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < g.base.nodes.length) :
    cutB g.base.canonIds (g.vecOf hv K) j = true ↔ g.base.termD (g.baseValid hv) j ∈ K := by
  unfold cutB
  rw [g.base.canonIds_getD (g.baseValid hv) j hj, g.vecOf_getD hv K _ (lt_of_le_of_lt (g.base.rep_le (g.baseValid hv) j) hj),
    g.base.canonIds_getD (g.baseValid hv) _ (lt_of_le_of_lt (g.base.rep_le (g.baseValid hv) j) hj), g.base.rep_rep (g.baseValid hv) j, (g.base.rep_spec (g.baseValid hv) j).2]
  simp
